structure.unit: Mutual Assessment Life, Accident and Sickness Insurers

law.text: Except as provided in this section, all mutual assessment life, accident and sickness insurers shall comply with all provisions of this title relating to insurers generally. Until July 1, 1990, those classes of insurance specified in Category A of § 38.2-3902 shall be exempt from this title, except this chapter and Chapters 5 and 6 of this title. In the event of conflict between the provisions of this chapter and other provisions of this title, the provisions of this chapter shall be controlling.
